Definition: properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change
BiblicalUsage: Chalaph means to change, to alter, to pass through. Laban changed Jacob's wages ten times, the law forbids changing a dedicated beast for another, Jael's hammer passed through Sisera's temples, and Samuel told Saul to go on forward from Tabor to the plain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe change is the word of this root in every direction: wages changed by a cheat, a vow that must not be changed, a hammer that passes through, and a road that goes forward. God changes what He will, and forbids what He will not.
